description.en: The ID of the data catalog.

description.zh: 翻页token，从返回结果返回，无则传空字符串或''。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. This value is returned in the response of a previous request. For the first request, pass an empty string ('').
The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: 数据表名称匹配正则表达式。
description.en: The regular expression that is used to match table names.

description.zh:
数据表的类型，取值如下：

MANAGED_TABLE：内部表。

EXTERNAL_TABLE：外部表。

VIRTUAL_VIEW：虚拟视图。

INDEX_TABLE：索引表。

MATERIALIZED_VIEW：物化视图。
description.en:
The type of the table. Valid values:

MANAGED\_TABLE: internal table.

EXTERNAL\_TABLE: foreign table.

VIRTUAL\_VIEW: virtual view.

INDEX\_TABLE: index table.

MATERIALIZED\_VIEW: materialized view.
